title: eludite.editor.hover input
description: Show Quick Info for a position (Edit > IntelliSense > Quick Info, Ctrl+K, Ctrl+I at the caret; resting the mouse over an identifier runs it with the mouse position). The tooltip shows the language server's hover text; it moves with scrolling and closes when the mouse leaves the word, on typing or on Escape.

path.description: Absolute path of an open document. Omit to act on the active document.

line.description: 1-based line to describe; the caret's line when omitted. The caret does not move.

column.description: 1-based column (characters) to describe; the caret's column when `line` is omitted, else 1.
